title: Poppy Flower
summary: A local Mergrass variant used in the Potion of Mind Reading recipe.

fields.Alchemy: Extract three Poppy Flowers into Suspension of Mergrass. Add any Sublimate to make a Potion of Mind Reading.
fields.Acquisition: House of Grief garden or the base of the Lower City graveyard mortuary stairs.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
